about: Frontier-written realisation hints in the Foundry IR for the corpus-derived L1 patterns (experiments/library/cards/catalog.json) that a sheet / e-mail / chat / webhook automation can use (claude-opus-5-5, 2026-10-22, written before any CI-1 builder call and from the catalog, not from any bed item). cues: extra words the BM25 retriever matches; shape: request-shape features (retrieve.mjs shapeOfRequest) that make a pattern a rule hit. Frozen by hash in research/ci1-20261021/MANIFEST.json.

P02.cues: sync copy export import transfer rows from one sheet to another
P02.hint: Read the source rows, transform them in ONE code node into exactly the rows to write (only the destination's columns), then write once (sheet.append for new rows, sheet.update / sheet.upsert with a key column for existing ones).

P08.cues: only if skip unless filter guard condition before sending
P08.hint: Decide in code which items qualify BEFORE any effect: a code node returns the qualifying list (and a boolean such as anyToSend); effects run over that list in a map, or carry "when" on the boolean. Normalise text before comparing (trim, lowercase) and treat missing values explicitly.

P12.cues: each every per row per item one message for each
P12.hint: One effect per item: a code node builds the list of messages (to, subject, body / text), then a map node whose body sends one message per item reading item.<field>. An empty list sends nothing.

P15.cues: summary digest report totals count overview weekly daily
P15.hint: Aggregate in code: compute counts and sums (round money to 2 decimals), build one message text listing the facts (ids, names, amounts, dates), and send it once; skip the send when the request says nothing should go out for an empty list.

P16.cues: duplicate dedupe already exists existing returning same email same phone unique
P16.hint: Identity by a normalised key (lowercased e-mail, digits-only phone, trimmed id). Read the sheet, look the key up in code, then either update the matching row (sheet.update with that key column) or append a new one; never append a second row for the same key.

P17.cues: match compare reconcile against purchase order receipt agreed price difference mismatch
P17.hint: Join the two sources by a normalised key in code, compare field by field, and return the discrepancies with their reasons; write or notify per discrepancy, and record the outcome (status + reason) on the checked row.

P36.cues: every morning daily weekly schedule each day at
P36.hint: Schedule runs: input.now is the firing time; derive today = now.slice(0, 10) (UTC) and compare YYYY-MM-DD dates as strings or as Date.parse(d + 'T00:00:00Z'). Read -> decide in code -> act -> write back what was done.

P37.cues: webhook form posts submission waits for answer respond validate
P37.hint: Webhook / form runs: validate input.event (input.event.body for a webhook) in a code node first; on invalid input answer the caller (reply.send with the status and body the request names) and do nothing else ("when" on a valid flag); otherwise act, then answer exactly once.

P38.cues: when a new row is added event status changes triggers
P38.hint: Event runs: treat input.event as the batch of new items; process each item in code, act per item, and leave existing rows alone unless the request says to change them.

P39.cues: new since last time changed poll check for new
P39.hint: Find what is new by comparing with what was recorded last time (a date or status column on the row); act only on the new or changed items and record the new marker in the same run.

P42.cues: so they don't get it again once only not twice already sent last reminder notified on remember
P42.hint: Cross-run memory lives in the sheet: before acting, skip rows whose marker column (status, last-sent date, stage, count) says it was already done; after acting, write the new marker on exactly the rows acted on (sheet.update keyed by the unique id column).

P58.cues: stage tier threshold days overdue escalate bracket level depending on
P58.hint: A decision table in code: an ordered list of rules (condition -> outcome) evaluated first-match, with the boundaries exactly as the request states them (>= vs >, inclusive ranges); keep the table in one place and derive texts and writes from the chosen outcome.

P27.cues: error failed failure alert notify on error
P27.hint: Expected bad input is a branch, not an error: classify it in code and route it (a review row, an alert, a rejection answer) with "when" flags.

P32.cues: approval approve manager review queue hand to a person
P32.hint: Hand-offs to a person are data, not effects you skip: write the item to the review sheet or notify the named person, and do not perform the guarded action yourself.

P04.cues: draft compose write message template greeting
P04.hint: Compose every message text in code from the row's facts (names, ids, amounts, dates exactly as stored or as the request formats them); put the facts the request lists in the body or subject.

P60.cues: deadline due expires expiry within days before after window
P60.hint: Time windows: compute whole days between dates in UTC (Math.floor or round as the request implies), and apply the window bounds exactly (e.g. 'within 3 days' = 0..3 inclusive unless stated); dates in the past are a separate case.
